title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Special-Order Deposit Multiplier for Members' Units
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a member's special-order deposit is scaled according to whether the unit on the call has been maintained under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. The records read are the agreement's status and its tune-up visit entries recorded as completed visits for the unit the call concerns.

**Rule.** For a member whose call concerns a unit with a completed Comfort Club tune-up on record, the deposit figured at the deposit rate is multiplied by 0.75. For a member whose call concerns a unit with no completed Comfort Club tune-up on record, it is multiplied by 0.9. For any other customer it is taken as figured. The multiplication comes before the single rounding to the cent.

| Customer | Completed Comfort Club tune-up on the call's unit | Deposit multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Member with an active agreement | Yes | 0.75 |
| Member with an active agreement | No | 0.9 |
| No active agreement | — | 1 (taken as figured) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical $386.00 parts amount at a 35 percent rate, which is $135.10 before scaling)

| Customer | Deposit |
|---|---|
| Member, unit tuned | $135.10 multiplied by 0.75, which is $101.325, rounded half up to $101.33 |
| Member, unit not tuned | $135.10 multiplied by 0.9, which is $121.59 |
| Non-member | $135.10 |
